review_candidates.title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer
review_candidates.description: About Camlin Camlin is a global technology leader that operates with the vision of bringing revolutionary products to life for a wide range of industries, including power and rail, and also has interests in a number of R&D projects in a variety of scientific sectors. At Camlin we believe in high quality engineering and design, allowing us to develop market leading products and services. In short, we love creating value for our customers by solving difficult problems. As of now, Camlin operates in over 20 countries worldwide.🌐 What to expect day to day: This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced Infrastructure Engineer who wishes to join a dynamic IT team. This role requires a senior level system administrator to provide administrative support focusing on the design, specification, integration and implementation on a large-scale end user computing architecture focusing mainly on a Microsoft based platform as part of a complex distributed network. The ideal candidate will be primarily responsible for our Microsoft Windows based systems, Office 365, SharePoint, E-mail, Teams, AD and applications, and their integration with the rest of our infrastructure. The successful candidate will take a leading role in our efforts in the design, implementation, and support of our Microsoft Windows based platforms and applications, both in the cloud and on-premise. You will be working alongside the small, existing team but will be expected to bring additional knowledge and experience to aid the growth and expansion of the company. This position is based in Lisburn but may require occasional visits to our other sites and offices. The successful candidate must be available for participation in the on-call rotation schedule and occasional travel. Responsibilities: Implement and support resilient on-premises, cloud and hybrid infrastructure environments. Administer Microsoft 365 services including Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive and Entra ID Manage Windows Server, Active Directory, Group Policy and Linux systems. Administer endpoint management platforms including Microsoft Intune and Windows Autopilot. Maintain enterprise networking, virtualisation, backup and disaster recovery solutions. Manage cybersecurity technologies including Microsoft Defender, Fortinet security solutions and identity protection controls. Develop and maintain automation solutions using PowerShell and other scripting tools. Monitor, maintain and optimise infrastructure performance, availability and security. Implement and maintain policies, standards and controls aligned with ISO27001 and industry best practices. Evaluate new technologies and contribute to infrastructure roadmaps and continuous improvement initiatives. Lead infrastructure projects, system upgrades, migrations and cloud adoption activities. Participate in the on-call rota supporting critical business services. What you'll need: Bachelor of Science degree in Computer Science, Management Information Systems, or related is required. Minimum 5 years' experience in a Systems Administrator, or Infrastructure Engineer role. Strong experience with Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Exchange Online, Teams and SharePoint. Advanced knowledge of Windows Server, Active Directory and identity management. Proven PowerShell scripting and automation experience. Experience managing Microsoft Intune and endpoint compliance solutions. Strong understanding of backup, disaster recovery and business continuity principles. Experience supporting hybrid cloud environments, particularly Microsoft Azure. Knowledge of enterprise networking technologies including DNS, DHCP, VPN and TCP/IP. Experience administering Windows and Linux environments. Strong understanding of cybersecurity best practices, vulnerability management and ISO27001 controls. Proven ability to deliver complex infrastructure projects and technical improvements. Excellent communication, documentation and stakeholder management skills. Nice to have but not essential: Experience with Fortinet technologies including FortiGate, FortiClient EMS, FortiManager and FortiAnalyzer. Experience with Microsoft Defender XDR, Microsoft Sentinel or similar security platforms. Experience with VMware vSphere, Hyper-V and Veeam Backup & Replication. Microsoft Azure, Security, Modern Workplace or Infrastructure certifications. Fortinet and VMware certifications. Experience in a global multi-site enterprise environment. Knowledge of Agile delivery methodologies. Experience supporting manufacturing, industrial or operational technology (OT) environments. Our Values We work together We believe in people We won’t accept the ‘way it has always been done’ We listen to learn We’re trying to do the right thing Equal Employment Opportunity Statement Individuals seeking employment at Camlin are considered without regards to race, colour, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital states, ancestry, physical or mental disability, gender identity or sexual orientation.

review_candidates.title: Infrastructure Administrator
review_candidates.description: Infrastructure Administrator Company: CampusWorks, Inc. Location: Mount Laurel, NJ Work Arrangement: On-site | Full-time Salary Range: $85,000–$92,000 annually About the Opportunity CampusWorks is seeking a skilled and motivated Infrastructure Administrator to support enterprise IT operations for one of our higher education clients in Mount Laurel, New Jersey. This is a dynamic, hands-on technical role that provides exposure to a broad range of enterprise technologies, including server infrastructure, virtualization, networking, cybersecurity, identity management, and cloud-connected services. The successful candidate will work closely with the Senior Infrastructure Engineer and broader IT team to maintain critical infrastructure, troubleshoot complex technical challenges, and contribute to ongoing infrastructure modernization and technology improvement initiatives. We are looking for someone who brings a strong technical foundation, takes ownership of their responsibilities, and is comfortable working across multiple technology disciplines in an evolving enterprise environment. Key Responsibilities - Administer, maintain, troubleshoot, and support enterprise Windows Server environments and related infrastructure. - Manage and support Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, Microsoft Entra ID, and hybrid identity services. - Support VMware, Hyper-V, and other enterprise virtualization technologies. - Maintain and troubleshoot enterprise networking infrastructure, including switches, VLANs, wireless networks, firewalls, VPNs, and network connectivity. - Monitor infrastructure availability, performance, capacity, and security, proactively identifying and resolving issues. - Support infrastructure security initiatives, including vulnerability remediation, patch management, system hardening, and access controls. - Administer and maintain enterprise backup, storage, disaster recovery, and business continuity systems. - Participate in infrastructure modernization projects, system migrations, technology deployments, and operational improvements. - Develop and maintain scripts, automation, technical documentation, and standardized operational procedures. - Collaborate with internal IT teams, technology vendors, and engineering resources to troubleshoot escalated issues and implement technical solutions. - Perform hands-on datacenter work, including server hardware installation, equipment maintenance, cabling, and physical troubleshooting. - Participate in scheduled after-hours maintenance and emergency support when necessary. Required Qualifications - Minimum of 3 years of professional experience supporting enterprise IT infrastructure, systems administration, networking, or related technologies. - Strong working knowledge of Windows Server, Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, and core enterprise infrastructure services. - Experience administering or supporting virtualization environments, such as VMware or Hyper-V. - Practical understanding of enterprise networking, including TCP/IP, switching, VLANs, wireless networking, firewalls, VPNs, and network troubleshooting. - Familiarity with infrastructure security principles, vulnerability management, patching, and secure system configurations. - Ability to independently investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve technical issues while recognizing when escalation or collaboration is appropriate. - Strong communication, documentation, organizational, and problem-solving skills. - Willingness to work directly with physical infrastructure and datacenter equipment. An associate degree in information technology, computer science, or a related field is preferred. Equivalent professional experience may be considered in place of formal education. Preferred Experience Experience in any of the following areas would be beneficial: - Microsoft 365, Azure, Entra ID, Google Workspace, and hybrid cloud technologies. - Enterprise networking platforms such as Cisco, Aruba, Fortinet, or Ruckus. - PowerShell, Python, Bash, or other scripting and automation technologies. - Linux administration. - Enterprise monitoring, RMM, endpoint management, and backup solutions. - Cybersecurity operations, identity security, and infrastructure hardening. - IT service management, change management, and incident response. Relevant industry certifications are valued but are not required in place of demonstrated technical competency. What We're Looking For This is not a narrowly defined systems administration position. Infrastructure operations span multiple technology disciplines, and priorities evolve as projects, initiatives, and operational requirements change. While strong systems administration and practical networking experience are important, we do not expect candidates to be experts in every technology listed. We value technical curiosity, adaptability, sound troubleshooting methodology, accountability, and a willingness to continuously learn and expand existing skills. The ideal candidate enjoys solving problems, collaborating with other technical professionals, and contributing to meaningful improvements across an enterprise IT environment. Compensation & Benefits - Annual base salary of $85,000–$92,000, depending on qualifications and experience. - Eligibility for CampusWorks' annual profit-sharing program. - Medical, dental, and vision insurance. - 401(k) retirement plan. - Health and wellness benefits. - Professional development opportunities. - Exposure to diverse enterprise technologies and infrastructure modernization initiatives. Apply If you're interested in joining a collaborative infrastructure team where you can apply your existing expertise while continuing to grow professionally, we encourage you to apply. Application Link: https://jobs.lever.co/campusworksinc/e23cbbce-92db-4097-be96-d189c78f126f CampusWorks is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Awareness of safeguarding, data protection and secure data handling when working onsite and implementing systems in education environments. review_candidates.title: Senior Systems & Infrastructure Engineer
review_candidates.description: New York Metropolitan Area | Primarily Remote with Occasional Client-Site Work Full-Time | $90,000-$120,000 Solve The Problems Other Engineers Escalate GEM Technologies is looking for an experienced Senior Systems & Infrastructure Engineer who enjoys solving difficult technical problems and taking ownership of them through resolution. This is a hands-on senior infrastructure position, not a management role or traditional help desk position. You will be one of the technical resources our team and clients rely on for complex infrastructure issues, production incidents, escalations, migrations and projects across multiple client environments. We are looking for an engineer who can step into a difficult situation, troubleshoot across technologies, determine the root cause, communicate clearly with the people involved, and remain accountable until the issue is resolved. If you enjoy being the engineer brought in when standard troubleshooting has not solved the problem, this may be a good fit. What You'll Do You will work across multiple client environments with different technologies, configurations and business requirements. Your responsibilities will include: Own the investigation and resolution of complex infrastructure incidents and escalations Administer and troubleshoot Windows Server, Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS and DHCP Support Microsoft 365 and Entra ID environments, including identity, authentication, MFA and Conditional Access Troubleshoot and support virtualization environments using VMware and/or Hyper-V Diagnose networking issues involving firewalls, VPNs, VLANs, routing, switching and connectivity Support backup, disaster recovery and business continuity systems Plan and execute infrastructure migrations, upgrades and modernization projects Perform root-cause analysis and implement or recommend changes that prevent recurring problems Use PowerShell, scripting, automation and other tools where they can improve reliability and efficiency Create and maintain clear technical documentation Work directly with clients, vendors and other GEM engineers during projects and technical incidents Provide occasional onsite support at client locations in the New York City metropolitan area What We're Looking For We care more about demonstrated technical depth, troubleshooting ability and ownership than a perfect list of certifications or products on a resume. Strong candidates will have substantial hands-on experience supporting production IT infrastructure and personally resolving complex technical problems. You should have strong experience in most of these areas: Microsoft Infrastructure Windows Server and Active Directory Group Policy, DNS and DHCP Microsoft 365 and Entra ID Identity, MFA and Conditional Access Virtualization and Core Infrastructure VMware vSphere/ESXi and/or Microsoft Hyper-V Server and storage infrastructure Backup and disaster recovery Networking and Security Firewalls, VPNs, VLANs, routing and switching Network and infrastructure troubleshooting System hardening, EDR, MFA and related security technologies You should also be comfortable communicating directly with clients and explaining complex technical issues to both technical and nontechnical audiences. Experience working for an MSP, technology consulting firm or other multi-client environment is strongly preferred. We will also consider engineers from complex internal IT environments who can demonstrate comparable technical breadth, independence and ownership. Working at GEM GEM Technologies is a managed IT and cybersecurity services company supporting organizations with complex technology environments. We are a small, experienced team. Senior engineers at GEM are not confined to one narrow technology or isolated within a large department. You will work across technologies, interact directly with clients and have meaningful responsibility for the systems and environments we support. That environment requires versatility and accountability, but it also provides something that can be difficult to find in a large organization: the opportunity to understand the complete environment, solve challenging problems and have a visible impact on the outcome. We value engineers who are curious, continue learning, share knowledge, document their work and take ownership. We also encourage the responsible use of AI, scripting and automation to improve troubleshooting, documentation and operational efficiency while maintaining appropriate security and protection of client information. Much of the work can be performed remotely. However, occasional onsite work at client locations in the New York City metropolitan area is an important part of the position. Candidates must be willing and able to provide onsite support when required. Requirements Experience That Will Set You Apart We are particularly interested in candidates with meaningful hands-on experience in one or more of the following: Microsoft Exchange Server and hybrid Exchange environments Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops (CVAD) Citrix NetScaler / ADC Advanced VMware infrastructure Advanced networking and firewall troubleshooting Veeam or similar backup and disaster recovery platforms PowerShell scripting and automation Infrastructure migrations and major upgrades Candidates should bring strong, hands-on proficiency across most of these technologies, with deeper expertise in several areas. We do not expect identical experience with every product in GEM's environment, but this is a senior infrastructure role and requires broad technical capability, demonstrated troubleshooting depth, and the ability to work independently across multiple systems. Benefits The anticipated salary range for this position is $90,000-$120,000 , depending on experience and demonstrated technical capabilities. GEM Technologies offers a competitive benefits package including health insurance, paid time off and other employee benefits. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States. GEM Technologies is not currently able to provide employment visa sponsorship. If you are an experienced infrastructure engineer who enjoys solving difficult problems, working across different technologies and taking responsibility from diagnosis through resolution, we would like to hear from you.
